turns.question: How much did a lead from search campaigns cost us in early October 2026?
turns.answer: A lead from search campaigns cost 46.00 EUR over 1 to 10 October 2026 (total search ad spend over total search leads; I took early October as 1 to 10 October because the question gave no exact dates).
